concept.hr: Vrijeme čekanja eksplodira kad iskorištenost ρ ide prema 1
concept.en: Waiting time explodes as utilisation ρ goes to 1

summary.hr: Pomiči opterećenje i gledaj red čekanja, srednje vrijeme i p99: od 90 % do 99 % kašnjenje naraste deset puta; varijabilnost diže rep, lanac zbraja p99.
summary.en: Move the load and watch the queue, the mean time and p99: from 90 % to 99 % latency grows tenfold; variability lifts the tail, a chain adds up p99.

concept.hr: ρ 0,5: srednje vrijeme 0,20 s, dvaput samo posluživanje; p99 0,92 s
concept.en: ρ 0.5: mean time 0.20 s, twice the service alone; p99 0.92 s

concept.hr: ρ 0,9: srednje vrijeme 1 s, deset puta posluživanje; p99 4,6 s
concept.en: ρ 0.9: mean time 1 s, ten times the service; p99 4.6 s

concept.hr: ρ 0,99: srednje vrijeme 10 s, p99 46 s; zadnjih 9 % opterećenja košta 10×
concept.en: ρ 0.99: mean time 10 s, p99 46 s; the last 9 % of load costs 10×

concept.hr: cv² od 1 na 9 uz ρ 0,1: srednje vrijeme ×1,4, p99 ×5
concept.en: cv² from 1 to 9 at ρ 0.1: mean time ×1.4, p99 ×5

concept.hr: p99 se zbraja po pozivima: 0,99 s s kraja na kraj, ispod cilja od 2 s
concept.en: p99 adds up along the calls: 0.99 s end to end, under the 2 s target
